aboutText: Based in Tottenham, DJH Plumbing & Carpentry specialises in a range of plumbing and carpentry services for local homes and businesses. With a commitment to environmental sustainability, I use the best quality materials within your budget to ensure lasting results. From emergency repairs to custom carpentry projects, you can rest assured of reliable and professional workmanship tailored to your needs.
servicesText: DJH Plumbing & Carpentry offers a full spectrum of plumbing and carpentry services across Tottenham and surrounding areas. From routine maintenance to complex installations, we deliver high-quality work using sustainable practices and durable materials.
